baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construction joins alaa, Rabb, and the dual act of takdhib.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal is governed by lordly nurture: benefits are not loose possessions but effects brought along toward completion, while takdhib actively repudiates their attribution.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the objects being counted and challenged.
Stage-by-stage nurture makes the giver an active maintainer rather than a remote owner.
Declaring a thing or its bearer false makes the dual verb an attributional refusal.

changed_reading.before: Which blessings do you two deny?
changed_reading.after: Which effects of your Lord's completing care will you two refuse to acknowledge as truly his?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Alaa and Rabb each carry binding branches, and takdhib can name failure to make a charge prove true.
baseline_models.mechanism: Oath, pact, and fulfilled charge converge on a forensic question: the favors are also claims upon the recipients, so denial can be breach rather than mere disbelief.

activation_trace.role: The oath branch gives alaa a binding, pledged edge alongside favor.
The pact branch turns lordly relation into protection carrying obligation.
A charge proves false when it is not carried through, making conduct evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: The question requests verbal assent to a list of gifts.
changed_reading.after: The question cross-examines whether the two recipients will carry their protected, benefited relation through or make its claim fail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root inventories connect Rabb with persistence and takdhib with milk that fails to last as expected.
baseline_models.mechanism: Provision is read temporally: nurture raises an expectation of continuance, while denial becomes the accusation that supply has disappointed that expectation.

activation_trace.role: Favors establish the provision whose reliability is under judgment.
Staying and lasting give lordship a temporal support function.
Milk that disappears against expectation supplies a material image of provision seeming to fail.

changed_reading.before: Denial means claiming that no gift was given.
changed_reading.after: Denial may also mean accusing the Lord's provision of not holding or lasting as promised.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual possessive and verb place two respondents inside an interrogative whose split alaa mapping includes following voices.
baseline_models.mechanism: A responsive voice follows a prior voice under a presiding authority; the verse can therefore function as a summons for two addressees to answer, not only as a proposition about them.

activation_trace.role: A voice following another supplies the call-and-response possibility from the non-dominant mapped root.
Authority and ownership supply the presiding speaker-recipient relation.
The dual declaration of falsehood is the answer demanded from both hearers.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a rhetorical question to two silent objects.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages two answerable voices under their Lord and presses them to respond in sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching first gives knowledge and then gives disclosure through speech; takdhib is consequently performed with a capacity that is itself among the alaa it rejects.

activation_trace.role: Favor anchors taught cognition and expression as gifts rather than neutral equipment.
Attributing falsehood names what the gifted expressive capacity is being used to do.
Knowledge becoming disclosed to a knower supplies the receptive capacity behind judgment.
Making meaning clear by speech or sign supplies the expressive instrument of denial.

structural_cues: 55:2 and 55:4 repeat teaching around 55:3's creation of the human.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies taught knowledge and taught expression; I infer that denial recursively spends those gifts against their giver. A live alternative is that expression is simply one item in the catalog without reflexive force.

changed_reading.before: The two recipients deny an external list of benefits.
changed_reading.after: Their very act of denial demonstrates and consumes a gifted capacity to know and articulate, making the refusal self-implicating.

context_deltas.mechanism: The established balance moves from cosmic order into commanded fair weighing; denial then resembles shortchanging reality, assigning the Lord's favors less weight than they bear.

activation_trace.role: Favors provide the goods whose value is being assessed.
A charge that fails to be carried through links falsehood to failed performance, not words alone.
The just balance supplies the normative scale for recognizing what is due.
Equity fixes the standard by which the weighing must proceed.
Short measure supplies the concrete action by which acknowledgment can be falsified.

structural_cues: 55:7 establishes the balance; 55:8-9 turn it into prohibitions and an imperative addressed to agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a cosmic balance and a ban on short measure; I infer an arrow from material valuation to epistemic-moral acknowledgment. Alternatively, the weighing sequence may remain a parallel duty rather than define takdhib.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an incorrect opinion about whether favors exist.
changed_reading.after: Denial is a corrupt weighing that withholds due value from real benefits and makes entrusted conduct fail its measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet concedes that created benefits end while the Lord remains; the provision-failure reading is therefore revised so that transience does not by itself prove the giver false.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors remain genuine even when they are not permanent.
Persistence attaches reliability to the Lordly source.
Provision failing to last supplies the expectation that the context corrects.
Ending after a period of continuance makes created duration explicitly finite.
Continuance relocates durability from the gift to the Lord's presence.

structural_cues: 55:26-28 places the recurring question immediately after the contrast between universal passing and the Lord's remaining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies passing creation and a remaining Lord; I infer that accusing a finite gift of broken reliability confuses gift with giver. Alternatively, impermanence itself may be the warning counted as favor.

changed_reading.before: A gift that disappears can be charged with having failed its promise.
changed_reading.after: The refrain asks whether the two will erase genuine finite gifts because they demanded the source's permanence from the gifts themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attempts to cross beyond the ordered domain require compelling warrant, while wrongdoing later becomes legible by marks and explicit denial meets its object; warning and exposed consequence expand alaa beyond pleasant goods.

activation_trace.role: The favor category is the element widened by the warning sequence.
Declaring a reality false links the refrain to the explicit denial later named in the packet.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the attempted escape from bounded order.
Compelling proof supplies the only stated warrant for passage.
Recognition from a trace makes accountability perceptible rather than hidden.
A visible identifying mark materializes the evidence by which actors are known.
The explicit act of declaring the threatened destination false realizes the refrain's verb inside the warning sequence.

structural_cues: Refrains at 55:34, 36, 38, 40, 42, and 45 interleave failed escape, rupture, recognition, seizure, and consequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosed limits, visible evidence, and explicit denial; I infer that intelligible warning is itself merciful provision. A live alternative is that the refrains condemn denial beside punishments without classing the warnings among the favors.

changed_reading.before: Alaa denotes only desirable provisions that invite gratitude.
changed_reading.after: Alaa can include the disclosure of limits and consequences that makes responsible return possible before denial becomes encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: Released waters meet without transgressing and yield coral; immediately around the focus, restrained sight and protected prior relation precede another coral image. Favor emerges as boundary-respecting relation rather than an object available for seizure.

activation_trace.role: Favor is recast from possessed object to the ordered relation that preserves value.
Nurturing administration supplies the agency that maintains fruitful limits.
Mixing and disturbance supply the live pressure toward contact and loss of distinction.
Two opposed things arriving together supplies encounter without requiring collapse.
Crossing a limit by aggression names the prohibited direction of encounter.
Restraint to a bounded object supplies disciplined relation in the immediate lead-in.
The glance localizes that restraint in perception rather than external enclosure alone.
Coral after the refrain echoes the precious outcome previously associated with bounded meeting.

structural_cues: The branchless root ط م ث at 55:56 occurs under negated prior contact and is used only as a structural cue, never as a branch citation.
55:57 interrupts the description between 55:56's relational restraint and 55:58's mineral-organic comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting, non-transgression, coral, restrained sight, and negated prior contact; I infer that protected relation enables precious emergence and governs the immediate description. Alternatively, these may be adjacent garden images without a causal bridge.

changed_reading.before: The beings described around 55:57 are counted as rewards available for possession.
changed_reading.after: The refrain asks whether the two will deny a favor constituted by mutual limit, protected relation, and value that appears without boundary violation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Springs run and later gush; joined to Rabb's nurture and gathered-water branches, the garden becomes a maintained circulation whose visible goods are downstream effects.

activation_trace.role: Favors name both the sustaining process and what it yields.
Abundant collected water gives lordship a hydrological material image.
Nurture and completion turn water from scenery into maintained growth.
Supply disappointing expected continuance poses the reliability question for the flow.
A source of running water supplies the origin point of the garden's circulation.
Continuing provision and giving make the flow durative rather than decorative.
Water welling in abundance intensifies the maintained-supply model.

structural_cues: Paired springs recur at 55:50 and 55:66 among repeated fruit and garden descriptions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies running and gushing sources amid produce; I infer a causal arrow from maintained water to abundance. Alternatively, springs and fruits may be parallel listed delights without an ecological mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The question points to a static inventory of garden objects.
changed_reading.after: The question points through the objects to continuous provisioning flows, asking which maintained circulation the two will accuse of failing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The maxim of good answered by good turns bestowal into a return circuit; the covenantal focus model gains an enacted response, and takdhib as a failed charge names refusal to complete it.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal initiates the relation to which a return can answer.
Pact and protection give reciprocity a binding relational frame.
Failure to carry a charge through makes denial an enacted breakdown of return.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the return arrow.
Good action occurs on both sides of the maxim, making reciprocity qualitative rather than merely transactional.

structural_cues: The focus refrain is followed by comparison at 55:58, another refrain at 55:59, and the reciprocity question at 55:60.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies good met by good; I infer that acknowledged favor seeks enacted good in return. A live alternative is that 55:60 describes reward from the giver only, without assigning reciprocal action to the recipients.

changed_reading.before: Acknowledgment ends in recognizing that a benefit came from the Lord.
changed_reading.after: Acknowledgment remains incomplete until received good is answered by good; denial is the practical failure of that return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Identical refrains before and after the focus activate the non-dominant following-voice branch: each question answers the preceding scene and solicits the next response from the dual hearers.

activation_trace.role: A responding voice anchors the focus as performed answer rather than inert label.
The dual declaration supplies the answer whose truth-status is pressed.
The preceding occurrence supplies one audible turn in the local response chain.
The following occurrence continues the answering voice beyond the focus.

structural_cues: The exact refrain at 55:55, 55:57, and 55:59 alternates with two-line descriptive units.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact recurrence, alternating units, and dual morphology; I infer performed antiphony from the following-voice branch. Alternatively, recurrence may intensify one speaker's rhetoric without assigning a responding voice.

changed_reading.before: The repeated verse is punctuation separating garden details.
changed_reading.after: The focus is one turn in a call-and-response sequence that makes both addressees repeatedly answerable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a textile branch of k-dh-b and a falsehood branch attached to a carpet term, not the ordinary verbal sense. It remains anchored in the focus verb and in actual lining, furnishing, and patterned-carpet context; downstream prose should present it only as an appearance-versus-interior analogy, never as a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Takdhib carries a branch for variegated cloth whose condition deceives, while the immediate lead-in names furnishings and their inner linings.

activation_trace.role: A cloth that deceives through its appearance turns denial into a surface-versus-truth problem.
Furnishings make the textile domain materially present immediately before the focus.
Garment lining distinguishes what is displayed from what lies within.
Fine patterned carpets extend the domain of costly visual surface.
A remote branch naming sheer falsehood creates an explicit cross-domain bridge back to the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: Denial is solely a proposition spoken against a fact.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, denial can be the suspicion or production of a splendid surface that lies about its interior, while the named lining invites inspection beneath display.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The activating k-dh-b idiom is zoological and branch-distant, but it remains anchored in the focus verb and mirrors the exact refrain's repeated position after a completed stretch. Render it only as a cadence analogy: the refrain behaves like a stop and backward inspection, not as the verse's lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A k-dh-b branch depicts running a stage, stopping, and looking behind; 55:57 occupies just such a recurrent checkpoint.

activation_trace.role: Running, stopping, and looking back supplies the kinetic shape of the focus checkpoint.
Following in sequence keeps the checkpoint attached to what precedes and what follows.
The prior refrain marks an earlier stop after a completed descriptive stage.
The next refrain confirms that the stop-and-review motion recurs.

changed_reading.before: The refrain merely closes the preceding unit.
changed_reading.after: The refrain pauses forward movement so the two hearers must look back over what just passed before the sequence resumes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mariners' chief is a specialized Rabb branch, so this cannot replace ordinary lordship. It remains worth carrying because the surah places the identical refrain after constructed vessels on the sea and describes them through guiding marks; qualify it as a navigational image of governance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus Rabb inventory includes the chief among sailors, allowing lordship to acquire a pilot-command image.

activation_trace.role: The sailors' chief gives abstract lordship a situated command role amid risk and movement.
Flowing movement supplies the vessels' passage through an unstable medium.
Sea-going supplies the navigational domain in which the chief image functions.
A conspicuous mark that guides supplies orientation for the towering comparison.

changed_reading.before: Rabb names authority in an abstract vertical hierarchy.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, Rabb is the skilled commander who gives moving lives orientation and passage across an expansive, risky field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The named shrub branch of alaa is homonymically distant from bestowed favors. It remains anchored in the focus noun and is activated by explicit tree and fruit imagery; downstream prose should frame beauty-with-bitterness as a material analogy for mixed-valence benefit, not as lexical substitution.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus alaa branch names a visually pleasing but bitter-tasting shrub.

activation_trace.role: The pleasing-looking, bitter plant supplies a mixed sensory profile for what can count as favor.
The stemmed tree makes the plant domain explicit early in the sequence.
Palatable fruit establishes taste as one way the surah renders benefit.

changed_reading.before: A favor must be immediately pleasant in both appearance and experience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, some alaa may attract by form yet carry a bitter demand, so difficulty does not automatically disprove beneficence.

strongest_changes: Taught knowledge and expression make denial recursively dependent on the gifts it rejects.
Balance and short measure turn denial into undervaluation enacted against an entrusted standard.
Passing gifts and a remaining Lord separate finite provision from the reliability of its source.
Interleaved warning scenes widen favor to include disclosed limits and intelligible consequences.
The 55:56-58 frame activates protected relation and non-transgression rather than possession.
summary.what_was_special: The focus supports several live mechanisms at once: benefaction, covenant, provision reliability, responsive performance, ecological maintenance, and boundary-respecting relation. Split-root branches and exact recurrence expose readings that a single paraphrase of blessings and denial would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The following-voice, textile, zoological, maritime, and shrub activations are branch-distant analogies, not proposed lexical senses in 55:57.
The causal arrow from protected boundaries to precious emergence is reader-supplied; juxtaposition remains live.
Warning may itself be a favor, or the refrain may only confront denial beside warning.
The branchless ط م ث cue supports immediate structure only and contributes no mapped identity or branch claim.
